segments.text: LOrde, what loue haue I vnto thy lawe? all the day long is my ſtudy in it.
Thou through thy cōmaundementes haſt made me wiſer then mine enemies: for they are euer with me.
I haue more vnderſtandyng then my teachers: for thy teſtimonies are my ſtudy.
I am wiſer then the aged: becauſe I kept thy commaundementes.
I haue refrayned my feete from euery euill waye: that I may kepe thy woorde.
I haue not ſhrinked from thy iudgementes: for thou teacheſt me.
O howe ſwete are thy woordes vnto my throte? yea ſweter then hony vnto my mouth.
Throughe thy commaundementes I gette vnderſtanding: therfore I hate al wicked wayes.
Glory be to the father, and to the ſonne. &c.
As it was in the beginning. &c. Amen.
